claims.claim: Actual B/C even continuum response has a rank-one t^-1/2 threshold tail with explicit nonzero coefficients.
An exact analysis null combination has t^-5/2 self-response and a finite absolute first moment; it is not substitution of the physical force.
The general matrix admits the stated nonthreshold C2 causal modulation estimate; its null self-channel admits the C1 estimate uniformly in real carrier, retaining causal slip.
The actual mixed odd J-F continuum kernel has an extra spectral zero and a t^-5/2 tail, with its shape oscillator separately retained.
The actual full cubic source is not identically spatial-threshold-null for any fixed g4; at g4=0 the fourth time derivative of its threshold amplitude is strictly positive.
No actual slow-envelope or full growing-window PDE theorem has been proved by these scalar/profile estimates.
The action, coefficients, geometry and preparation remain supplied; no natural evolution law is selected.
